0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 2-3 on the road, 8th in the East) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central, 3rd in the East), who have one game still to play before this one and are coming off a 1-game losing streak. Washington is missing Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost the season series 1-3, including a 117-95 defeat in Washington on March 19, 2026.
